title: Insights into the mechanism of electrode degradation and performance enhancing strategies for iron-ion batteries using X-ray absorption spectroscopy
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01206F, Paper
Jitendra Kumar Yadav, Subhajit Nandy, Keun Hwa Chae, Jitendra Pal Singh, Ambesh Dixit
Fe-ion batteries offer low cost, earth abundance, and eco-friendly operation. X-ray absorption spectroscopy reveals electrode structural changes, Fe redox behavior, and degradation pathways, enabling strategies for improved stability and performance.
